model.n_action_steps_note: Explicit override from checkpoint default 50, held constant for the current Control UI P and both fine-tuned arms. Ten flow steps per policy call; each call executes up to ten native actions. Native UI and evaluation render 256x256.

environment.scene_replacement: Use the actual native LIBERO scene for observation, human collection, training and evaluation. Factory reskin is deferred.

P+R_prime.objective: human recovery to verified resumable state

collection.heldout_scope: Held out from intervention fine-tuning, not claimed unseen in original pretraining.
collection.video_split_note: Video starts are a subset of the held-out test pool, not additional independent test examples.
collection.collection_layout_note: Collect 10 human interventions across the 25 collection layouts. Qualification is checked after collection. Each qualified source episode contributes at most one R-prime and one R segment; observed counts may be below 10.

training_proposal.checkpoint_selection: fixed_final_step; use separate validation only if selecting a different checkpoint

deliverables.task: Paired autonomous P versus P+R task completion successes/attempts on identical held-out normal starts and policy RNG seeds, fixed 0-100 percent chart with Wilson intervals.
deliverables.recovery: P+R_prime actual inference clip from held-out failed state 3prime to independently verified resumable state 2; stop the clip at recovery completion.

task_selection.objective: Choose a task/condition where P has meaningful ability and repeated correctable failures, before intervention collection.

evaluation_protocol.environment_seed_rule: 10000 + initial_state_id; same reset for both policy RNG seeds
evaluation_protocol.object_layout_source: official native LIBERO init states, saved and applied identically to each arm
